usedFor: Trello holds cards for signups or contacts, and ClearBounce checks whether an email address can be delivered to. A “New Card Created” in Trello can run “Verify Email Address” in ClearBounce on the address from the card.

bestTemplate.name: “New Card Created” in Trello, then “Verify Email Address” in ClearBounce
bestTemplate.why: Each new card has its address checked once, as the card appears. “Create Bulk Job” fits a batch instead, and it returns only a job ID.

watchOut: “Add Label to Card” is also a trigger here, so labeling an existing card sends its address through “Verify Email Address” again. Pick the trigger that matches when you want the check.
